stem: Which quotation from “The Low-Tech Appeal of Little Free Libraries” best supports the message of “Hunger for Books”?

options.label: A
options.text: In some places, Little Free Libraries are filling a role usually served by brick-and-mortar libraries; the organization’s Books Around the Block program, for example, aims to bring LFLs to places where kids and adults don’t have easy access to books.

options.label: B
options.text: “I hoped to share that feeling with my neighbors—that’s the reason I wanted a Little Free Library.”

options.label: C
options.text: “We have a natural sense of wanting to be connected, but there are so many things that push us apart,” Bol says. “I think Little Free Libraries open the door to conversations we want to have with each other.”

options.label: D
options.text: “Reading books is one of the most valuable things in my life. I think a book is equal to a treasure,” he says.
